newsitem.title: CANADA: Biron Bay to merge with Royal Grp.
newsitem.headline: Biron Bay to merge with Royal Grp.

text.p: Biron Bay Resources Ltd said on Monday it would merge with Royal Ecoproducts Ltd, a unit of Royal Group Technologies Ltd in a reverse takeover share deal.

Under the merger proposal, Biron Bay shareholders would receive one new subordinate voting share of the amalgamated company for every 2.92 Biron Bay common shares held, while Ecoproducts shareholders would receive one new subordinate voting share and one new multiple voting share of the merged entity for every one Ecoproducts subordinate voting share and multiple voting share, respectively, held.
The merger was subject to shareholder approval at a meeting to be held on April 30, Biron Bay said.
If approved, Biron Bay would be renamed Royal Ecoproducts Ltd and Biron Bay's mining resource assets would be carried on a maintenance basis as a separate division of the continuing company.
"It is expected that these resource assets would be developed or disposed of in the ordinary course of business when appropriate to realize upon their potential," the companies said.
The merger would result in Royal Group Technologies having an equity interest in the merger company of 74.3 percent and a voting interest not exceeding 80 percent.
